local_composition.tool: Remotion 4.0.524, standalone entry motion/concept-spec-story/ (not wired into src/Root.tsx)
local_composition.structure: Intro + 4 beats + outro, 30fps timeline: 0-45f intro, 45-160f beat 1, 160-270f beat 2, 270-390f beat 3, 390-497f beat 4, 510-538f outro, crossfaded with staggered kinetic word reveals
elements: Kinetic Beatrice headings — per-word spring entrance, clay-accented key words

Photo cards — spring scale/slide entrance, gentle sinusoidal float, rounded shadowed frames around the four generated photographs, all captions rendered live in Beatrice (no AI-generated text on any image)
Quantity counter — locally computed count-up (0 to 58 sq ft) via interpolate, no AI text
Approval — locally drawn SVG checkmark (stroke-dashoffset draw-on) plus Beatrice caption

Shared-record node — 'The Spec' pill connected by locally drawn quadratic SVG paths (draw-on) to three chips (Homeowner / Trade / Supplier), each with a hand-authored lucide-style line icon from motion/concept-shared/icons.tsx
Outro bookend — same Beatrice wordmark treatment as hero.mp4 for continuity
